research_lines.note: originated rating line — HLTV ranking points, Valve Regional Standings points → Elo-400 logistic → BO3 series transform

Series length BO3 as stated by the research source named on this row (Polymarket market title ("mellren vs Privateer Gaming (BO3) - CCT Europe Closed Qualifier: Series #12 Group D") — title only; the market's prices are refused, see refusals); Hotspawn states none. Polymarket opened a market for this card (cs2-mellre-pg5-2026-10-16, title states BO3) but the book is uninitialised: it prints 94¢ for mellren and 93¢ for Privateer Gaming (both sides above 90¢, sum $1.87 for a $1 pair) with $0.00 volume. Ingesting those numbers would invent a ~50/50 that no trader believes, so the prices are refused (see refusals). The row keeps its originated line from the official Valve points (mellren 932 vs Privateer 608) cross-checked on HLTV (#94 vs #226), and the series length is taken from the market title only. Rating inputs: mellren 932 vs Privateer 608 official points; project 400-point logistic with independent-map series transform, BO3: 95.1%. This is an uncalibrated project estimate, not a Valve match forecast.
